scores.notes: Moses on the left shore (pointing, staff) and Moses at the front of the line on the right are both an elderly man with wavy white hair and a full white beard and similar build; only the pose differs.
Jesus by the coal fire (left) and standing in the stern (right) has the same long dark centre-parted hair, short dark beard, oval face and olive skin.

Both show a wooden mast-and-rigging fishing boat on rough water with hills and a stone town on the left shore. The light changes from a stormy sunset glow (right) to a moonlit night (left), which fits one evening rather than night against day.

Both show a round pit lined with stone blocks, a round plank lid moved aside and iron-barred grilles at the top. The left is seen from outside at dawn and the right from inside, and the arrangement matches.

The Israelite file (left) walks between dark teal water walls under a night sky lit by the fire pillar. The chariot scene (right) has bright green translucent walls under a pale daylight/dawn sky with no fire pillar, so night conflicts with day.

The chariot scene (left) is under a pale daylight/dawn sky with bright green water walls. Moses (right) stands under a dark night storm sky lit only by fire in the clouds, between dark teal walls on a wet seabed, so day conflicts with night.

Both show a rough stone farmhouse among olive trees and cypresses, terraced fields and a lake with hills behind, in warm daylight. The doorway (left) and the dirt road near the house (right) fit one homestead.

Both show the seabed at night between towering dark teal water walls, with a rocky floor, low cliffs at the far end and fire glowing in the sky. Moses at the entrance (left) and the walking file (right) fit one crossing.
Both show a wooden mast-and-oar fishing boat on rough dark water under a cloud-veiled full moon at night, with a hilly shore (a town at left in the left panel, hills at right in the right panel).

Both show a rain-swept storm at night under a full moon, with the same kind of wooden boat (mast, oars, woven cushion in the stern) and a hilly shore. The stone village on the right panel's shore fits the far coast.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore at hazy sunrise, a hillside village of flat-roofed stone houses with palms and cypresses, and a small charcoal fire on the beach by a wooden boat with nets.

Daniel on the left has fair olive skin, a broad square face and neat swept-back grey hair. On the right he has clearly darker brown skin on face and hands, a gaunt narrow face and tousled curly hair, despite the same blue cloak and scroll case.

Both show a wooden sailboat swamped in heavy storm waves under dark clouds, with a dim amber glow at the horizon and a hilly shore with stone buildings. The torn sail and bailing crews fit one stormy evening.
Both show the same night scene: a moon behind clouds, rough dark water, a wooden boat with mast and oars, and a stone town on a headland on the left shore.

Both show a wooden fishing boat with a mast and a lit lantern at night on the lake, with a stone town on a hilly shore. The left is the dark storm and the right the moonlit calm, which fits one night.
Both show the same lakeshore in soft morning light: a pebbly beach with a small coal fire, a wooden boat at the water's edge, and a green hillside with palms, cypresses and flat-roofed stone houses.

The right shows Peter leaping from the boat (curly grey hair, grey beard), but the left description names no individual disciple, so Peter cannot be singled out among the group on the beach (the foreground man carrying the net looks similar, but nothing identifies him as Peter).

Both show a circular den with walls of large grey stone blocks, an iron-barred grille at the upper level and lions lying on the floor below. The open view (left) and the rim with its moved lid (right) fit one structure seen from different angles.

Both show a dusty dirt road winding between dry-stone walls through terraced olive groves with cypresses and rolling hills in warm daylight. The stone farmhouse on the right fits the farm buildings on the left.

Both show the seabed at night between tall dark teal-green water walls, with a dark clouded sky and moonlight. The sandy floor of the chariot view (left) and the rocky floor of the walking crowd (right) fit one crossing seen from different spots.

Daniel on the left has short cropped dark-grey hair, a full white beard and a broad face. On the right he has collar-length swept-back grey hair, a short grey stubble beard and a leaner, younger-looking face, so hair and beard conflict.

Both are night scenes of the parted sea with teal-green water and a dark clouded sky. The open path between the walls (left) and the shore view with the sea starting to part (right) fit one crossing and one occasion.
Both show a moonlit night with teal-green waves parting onto a sandy seabed and a walled town on reddish cliffs at upper right, matching closely across the two viewpoints.
